name: Vardion
about: Vardion (class 1052), First Acolyte of the Enclave on Daemon's Crag, one of the two mentors; dies if Bane wins (G[142:2] = 2). INT-gated topic (PLAN-LEVELING.md 5; game/npc_dialog.h 'avatar_int'): shown only when the Avatar's INT is at least the number, behind New Dialogue.

topics.label: Your grandmother believed in other worlds. What did she study?
say: You are bold to ask after my family, stranger. Bold, or clever. I have not decided which.
Mordra studied the edges of things. Where the fire meets the stone, where one place ends and another begins. She said every wall has a far side.
Then one day she was gone. No body, no ash. Some said a daemon took her. I prefer to think she found a far side and walked through it.
Honesty can be as deadly as deceit, if it is not tempered by wisdom. So I will say only this: if you find her road, you will tell me. That is not a request.
